svg.title: THE HOKUTEN GROUP — character-grid hotel study (gold)
svg.desc: A photograph of a Hokuten Group hotel closing rendered as a grid of HOKUTEN letters, digits and 北天 accent marks. One line resolves into the words THE HOKUTEN GROUP.
